newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish shares end lower on New York, Astra fall.
newsitem.headline: Swedish shares end lower on New York, Astra fall.

text.p: Swedish shares ended lower on Thursday, following New York's fall on Wednesday and a weak U.S. opening, as well as a sharp decline in Astra.
The exchange's general index fell 0.9 percent to 2,635.92 in turnover of 5.55 billion crowns
Astra dropped seven to 351.5 crowns, possibly hit by a negative news report, dealers said.
Investment company Investor fell nine crowns to 336.5 after releasing 1996 earnings.
Forestry group AssiDoman rose three crowns to 190 crowns after presenting 1996 figures and forecasting a market pickup.
The bank and insurance sector was hit by profit taking after recent euphoria, down 0.73 percent but came off day lows.
Swedbank fell 1.5 crown to 152.5 but its soon-to-be bride Foreningsbanken rise 0.8 crowns to 46.8 crowns. S-E-Banken also rose, up one to 81, while Nordbanken fell nine to 271.
Truck maker Scania kept sliding after presenting earnings earlier this week, down five to 178.
Automotive group Volvo rose two to 181, supported by presenting 1996 earnings a day earlier.
